rows.medi_said: How do you say my clothes? Is it أَوَا...

rows.amal_said: نفس never takes ال before it. Al-always after it.
rows.why: He put el- on نفس after the noun; she named the rule that نفس never takes el- and comes before the noun.

rows.amal_said: صح. / نفس never takes ال before it always after and it's before the noun.
rows.why: He put نفس after the noun with el-; she restated the rule and he said نفس الأشخاص.

rows.amal_said: Why ال آخر؟ / آخر الأسبوع صح، بس مش ال آخر الأسبوع. أغلب آخر الأسبوع.
rows.why: In a three-noun chain only the last noun takes el-; she rejected ال آخر and gave أغلب آخر الأسبوع.

rows.why: العربية is Arabic (language) / feminine; for Arabs she gave العرب or العربيين.

rows.amal_said: أول شو؟ / What's one? What's one?
rows.chat: taani ijtimaa3 kaan nafs awal waa7ad
rows.why: The same as the first one needs واحد after أول; she prompted What's one? and he said أول واحد.
rows.english: the same as the first one
rows.proposed_rule: An ordinal or superlative standing for the ... one takes waa7ad / wa7de after it, matching the noun: nafs awal waa7ad, a7san wa7de.

rows.medi_said: Ba'id ma shufna. After we saw...
rows.amal_said: That. You didn't-- You did-- You need a that here.
rows.chat: ba3ed ma shufna enno tani mat3am kaan nafs el-ishi, rawwa7na
